exercises.instruction: В некоторых из этих предложений much использовано не совсем верно. Измените предложения или напишите OK.

items.prompt: Do you drink much coffee?
I drink much tea.
It was a cold winter. We had much snow.
There wasn’t much snow last winter.
It costs much money to travel around the world.
We had a cheap holiday. It didn’t cost much.
Do you know much about computers?
’Do you have any luggage?’ ’Yes, much.’

exercises.instruction: Напишите предложения об этих людях. Используйте much и a lot.

items.prompt: James loves films. (go to the cinema)
answers: He goes to the cinema a lot.

items.prompt: Nicola thinks TV is boring. (watch TV)
Tina is a good tennis player. (play tennis)
Mark doesn’t like driving. (use his car)
answers: He doesn’t use his car much.
He doesn’t use his car a lot.

items.prompt: Paul spends most of the time at home. (go out)
answers: He doesn’t go out a lot.

items.prompt: Sue has been all over the world. (travel)

exercises.instruction: Переведите предложения на английский язык. (DVD-диски = DVDs, на конференции = at the conference)

items.prompt: У нас есть много DVD-дисков.
answers: We have a lot of DVDs.
We’ve got a lot of DVDs.

items.prompt: На конференции было много человек?
answers: Were there a lot of people at the conference?
Were there many people at the conference?

items.prompt: Ирина много читает. У неё есть много книг.
answers: Irina reads a lot. She has a lot of books.
